verdict.rationale: Apify's own docs state that users can share Actors (scrapers) with other people and manage organizations and permissions, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single summary line from the docs index, with no detail on how permissions work and no corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit role-based permission model (roles and granularity), detailed first-party docs on organization and teammate management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share scrapers with teammates and manage organizations and role-based permissions

citations.quote: Share Actors with other people, manage your organizations and permissions.
Apify is all about Actors—a new way to package your code to make it easy to share, integrate, and build upon.
